verdict.rationale: Substantive guidance text was extracted from ELSTER's public pages (the Unternehmer info page and the homepage). That implies the public reading surface returned real content rather than a CAPTCHA or an empty JS shell. However, no probe explicitly records a keyless, identified-UA fetch of these guidance pages. The one direct probe shows the related ERiC artifact host (esteuer.de) timing out for a keyless client, which counts against front-door access to the wider public surface even though it is not the guidance pages themselves. Missing for 10: explicit dated probe of elster.de guidance pages with an identified user agent, confirmation of server-rendered HTML with no bot wall, and consistent reachability of the related public hosts.
